name: Cervical Isometric Rotation
steps: Sit or stand in an upright, balanced posture with your chin level.
Place your left hand on the left side of your head near your temple and cheekbone.
Attempt to turn your head to look over your left shoulder.
Use your hand to provide equal and opposite resistance, preventing any actual turning.
Hold the isometric rotation for 5 to 10 seconds while maintaining steady breathing.
Gradually release the pressure and repeat on the opposite side.
coaching_cues: The head must remain facing squarely forward throughout the contraction.
Keep your jaw relaxed and teeth unclenched.
Apply smooth, controlled pressure without jerking.
